page_title: VAL 2-2 ALA | Valencia v Alaves 22/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+13' Pepelu (Valencia) will miss the next game.
90+12' Pepelu (Valencia) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Javier Alberola had an easy-decision to make.

90+8' 2 - 2 Diego Lopez sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Dani Gomez (Valencia) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot which hits the right post and bounces in off it. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:2.
90+8' Hugo Duro (Valencia) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
90+7' Pepelu (Valencia) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+5' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) poorly executes the free kick and the ball only hits the wall.
90+3' Pepelu (Valencia) takes the free kick from a long way out but the defender manages to get it clear.
90+3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) makes a strong challenge and Javier Alberola blows for a foul. Free kick. Valencia will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90' The fourth official shows 11 min. of added time.
88' 1 - 2 Goal! Joan Jordan (Alaves) puts the ball into the top left corner past the outstretched arm of Stole Dimitrievski.
87' Joan Jordan (Alaves) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
86' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is punished with the yellow card.

86' Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) brings his opponent down. Javier Alberola has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Alaves are given a huge opportunity to score - it's a penalty kick!
84' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) serves up a nice cross, but Jesus Owono punches the ball away.
81' That's the end of the game for Carlos Martin, who is replaced by Tomas Conechny (Alaves).
80' Stoichkov will be replaced by Ander Guevara (Alaves).
80' Substitution. Adrian Pica is replaced by Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves).
78' Ruben Baraja has decided to make a change. Dani Gomez (Valencia) replaces Javi Guerra.
78' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Enzo Barrenechea walks off the pitch to be replaced by Pepelu (Valencia).
77' The resulting set piece from Valencia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' Adrian Pica (Alaves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
75' Adrian Pica (Alaves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
73' Hugo Duro (Valencia) commits a foul and Javier Alberola immediately signals a free kick.
70' 1 - 1 Goal! Luis Rioja (Valencia) puts the ball into the bottom right corner past the outstretched arm of Jesus Owono.
70' Luis Rioja (Valencia) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
69' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Valencia!

67' Play continues despite the shouts by some Valencia players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Javier Alberola interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
66' PENALTY APPEAL after Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
63' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Javi Guerra (Valencia) takes it short.
62' Javi Guerra (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play. Valencia will have a chance to score from a corner.
62' Carlos Martin (Alaves) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
61' Valencia couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Jesus Owono (Alaves) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
61' Kike Garcia (Alaves) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
58' Javier Alberola blows the whistle, Cristhian Mosquera (Valencia) is penalised for a foul.
54' Antonio Sivera is being substituted because of an injury. Eduardo Coudet sends Jesus Owono (Alaves) on the pitch.
53' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
49' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
48' Javi Guerra (Valencia) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
47' Flag up against Andre Almeida (Valencia). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
47' Sergi Canos (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ruben Baraja is forced to make a change. Fran Perez is unable to continue due to injury, Sergi Canos (Valencia) comes on.
43' Hugo Duro (Valencia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
40' Stoichkov (Alaves) touches the ball with his hand.
39' Javier Alberola interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Enzo Barrenechea (Valencia).
38' Fran Perez (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
36' Joan Jordan (Alaves) takes the corner but it's cleared.
36' Alaves can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
35' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

34' Stoichkov (Alaves) collects the ball on the edge of the box and produces a precise shot which would have ended inside the right post, if Stole Dimitrievski hadn't pulled off a wonderful save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
33' Andre Almeida (Valencia) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
28' The game is interrupted. Diego Lopez (Valencia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
26' Hugo Duro (Valencia) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Javier Alberola who sees an offensive foul.
22' What was Carlos Martin (Alaves) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
22' Kike Garcia (Alaves) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
18' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul.
17' The referee signals a substitution. Stoichkov (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Jon Guridi.
15' It doesn’t look good for Jon Guridi (Alaves); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
14' The game is interrupted now, Jon Guridi (Alaves) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
12' Adrian Pica (Alaves) gets on the end of the resulting set piece and sends in a snap shot from the edge of the box. However, it sails high over the bar.
11' The referee points to the corner flag and Alaves will take a corner.
11' Jon Guridi (Alaves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
10' Andre Almeida (Valencia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
10' Alaves are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! Carlos Martin (Alaves) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 0:1. He was ably assisted there by Kike Garcia.

6' A nice pass finds Andre Almeida (Valencia) in space. He sets himself up and hammers in a fantastic low shot from distance that looks bound for the middle of the goal, but the out of position Antonio Sivera pulls off a breathtaking save to deny him.
5' A quickly taken corner by Valencia.
5' Diego Lopez (Valencia) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. Valencia win a corner.
3' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a cross into the box, but Antonio Sivera comes off his line to gather the ball.
2' Kike Garcia (Alaves) is flagged for offside.
1' Kike Garcia (Alaves) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Valencia will kick-off.
Javier Alberola will referee today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
Show lineups
